thread:
lena: quick status for Thimble week0 private/VPC onboarding. Two live blockers: 1) TGW route propagation not reaching two child RTs, 2) KMS alias rotation broke our SIEM forwarder.

mike-net: which TGW attachment id?

lena: tgw-attach-0d4f3b2a. Their terraform created per-AZ RTs and set propagate=false in two AZs.

tom-sre: i can flip propagate=true for the child RTs. doing a dry-run first.

sarah-ops: on KMS: forwarder logs show "AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt" for alias/thimble-logs after yesterday's rotation. They prefer not to edit key policy.

alex-csm: thimble secops prefers grants. can we create a short-lived grant for our rwd-forwarder-role to unblock smoke?

tom-sre: yes, plan: (A) patch TGW propagate flags, (B) create 24h KMS grant for arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-forwarder-role, (C) run forwarder smoke.

infra-bot: scheduled job: tgw-prop-check for thimble at 2024-06-26T09:15:00Z.

tom-sre: propagate change applied to rt-0a1b2c3 and rt-0a4b5c6. validating connectivity.

mike-net: traceroute from thimble-app1 -> 10.120.9.7 now reaches our infra hop. good.

infra-bot: scheduled job: create-temp-kms-grant for thimble at 2024-06-26T09:20:00Z.

tom-sre: created grant g-12ab34cd for 24h. triggering forwarder test.

sarah-ops: forwarder smoke: Decrypt=SUCCESS, event landed in thimble-soc-smoke index. SIEM confirmed.

alex-csm: great. two follow-ups for Thimble: (1) SecOps to agree permanent CMK approach (policy vs automated grant), (2) commit propagate=true fix to their terraform.

renewals-bot: account health: usage 14% of commit (30d). renewal-risk=medium if onboarding not finished in 10 business days.

lena: noted renewal flag in CRM with notes and recommended weekly exec sync until usage >50% of commit.

mike-net: PR opened to add preflight checks: verify TGW propagate flags, verify KMS alias mapping, verify assume-role trust. link: https://git.internal/rwd/onboard/pulls/411

lena: summary: TGW propagation fix ✅, temp KMS grant ✅ (forwarder smoke green), pending: Thimble Sec sign-off on perm key policy, terraform commit. i'll update onboarding tracker and schedule exec sync if no perm-policy in 48h. thanks all :sparkles:
